msg.dn.help:
§e/dn command overview§r, type §b/dn <command> help§r for details:
  §aopen§r open warehouse/Special Ops/workbench overview/trading hall
  §areload§r reload all configs
  §aexport§r export config backup
  §asetting§r global settings
  §awarehouse§r warehouse config
  §asafe§r safe box
  §agrid§r grid-inventory config
  §aclass§r item class config
  §aperm§r permissions
  §atrade§r trading hall management
  §ainfo§r show current config
  §aworkbench§r workbench management
  §arecipe§r recipe management
  §atree§r upgrade tree management
  §adata§r player data
  §aweb§r web editor
  §aspawner§r spawn system (zero-activity)
msg.dn.help.open:
§e/dn open§r open UIs:
  §a/dn open warehouse§r open the warehouse (key B)
  §a/dn open special§r open Special Ops (key V)
  §a/dn open manufacture§r open the workbench overview (key G)
  §a/dn open trade§r open the trading hall
msg.dn.help.reload: §e/dn reload§r hot-reload recipes / upgrade tree / workbenches / permissions / safe-box limits / trade config without a restart
msg.dn.help.setting:
§e/dn setting§r global settings:
  §a/dn setting speed <0.01-100>§r crafting speed multiplier (new tasks only)
  §a/dn setting queue <1-100>§r max parallel queue per workbench
  §a/dn setting mode offline|online§r crafting timer mode
  §a/dn setting currency scoreboard <objective>§r scoreboard currency (default dn_money)
  §a/dn setting currency vault§r Vault economy
  §a/dn setting currency playerpoints§r PlayerPoints points
msg.dn.help.warehouse:
§e/dn warehouse§r warehouse config (max level from the upgrade tree; rows auto-expand):
  §a/dn warehouse rows <1-64>§r total rows (9 slots each)
  §a/dn warehouse slots <0-576>§r base unlocked slots
msg.dn.help.info:
§e/dn info§r show the current full config:
  §a/dn info§r global / warehouse / safe box / permissions / grid / trade values
msg.dn.help.workbench:
§e/dn workbench§r workbench management:
  §a/dn workbench list§r list all workbenches
  §a/dn workbench add <id> <name>§r add a workbench
  §a/dn workbench remove <id>§r remove a workbench
  §a/dn workbench rename <id> <newName>§r rename a workbench
msg.dn.help.recipe:
§e/dn recipe§r recipe management (held item includes NBT):
  §a/dn recipe list <workbenchId>§r list recipes
  §a/dn recipe get <recipeId>§r show details
  §a/dn recipe add <workbenchId> <recipeId>§r create an empty recipe
  §a/dn recipe remove <recipeId>§r delete a recipe
  §a/dn recipe rename <recipeId> <name>§r set the display name
  §a/dn recipe addinput|addoutput <recipeId>§r add input/output from held item
  §a/dn recipe delinput|deloutput <recipeId> <index>§r remove input/output
  §a/dn recipe setinput|setoutput <recipeId> <index> <count>§r set count
  §a/dn recipe time <recipeId> <seconds>§r set duration
  §a/dn recipe level <recipeId> <level>§r set required warehouse level
  §a/dn recipe parallel <recipeId> <limit>§r set max parallel crafts
  §a/dn recipe reload§r reload all recipes
msg.dn.help.tree:
§e/dn tree§r upgrade tree management (max level = highest node):
  §a/dn tree get§r show the tree
  §a/dn tree add|remove <level>§r add/remove a level node
  §a/dn tree cost <level> <cost>§r set the cost
  §a/dn tree slots <level> <slots>§r set unlocked slots
  §a/dn tree additem <level>§r add material from held item
  §a/dn tree delitem <level> <index>§r remove a material
  §a/dn tree setitem <level> <index> <count>§r set material count
msg.dn.help.data:
§e/dn data <player>§r player data:
  §a/dn data <player> get§r show data
  §a/dn data <player> level <level>§r set warehouse level
  §a/dn data <player> slots <count>§r set unlocked slots
  §a/dn data <player> safe <level>§r set safe box level
  §a/dn data <player> reset§r reset warehouse and safe box (items kept)
msg.dn.help.safe:
§e/dn safe§r safe box config (default 1x1, max 3x3):
  §a/dn safe size <width> <height>§r default size (1~3 x 1~3)
  §a/dn safe get§r show default size and upgrade tree
  §a/dn safe add|remove <level>§r add/remove a level node
  §a/dn safe cost <level> <cost>§r set the cost
  §a/dn safe rows <level> <rows> <cols>§r set unlocked rows x cols
  §a/dn safe additem|delitem|setitem <level> ...§r material add/remove/update
  §a/dn safe restrict <item|any> <exact|contains> <nbt>§r add an NBT restriction
  §a/dn safe restrictions§r list restrictions
  §a/dn safe unrestrict <index>§r remove a restriction

msg.dn.help.class:
§e/dn class§r item class colors (same as /dn grid class):
  §a/dn class list§r show classes and item assignments
  §a/dn class set <name> <R> <G> <B>§r set class color (0~255)
  §a/dn class remove <name>§r remove a class
  §a/dn class setclass <itemId> <name>§r assign an item to a class
  §a/dn class unsetclass <itemId>§r remove the item class
msg.dn.help.grid:
§e/dn grid§r grid-inventory config (synced to clients automatically):
  §a/dn grid list§r show custom sizes / hotbar rules / registered containers
  §a/dn grid size <width> <height>§r set held item footprint (1~9)
  §a/dn grid remove <itemId>§r remove a custom size
  §a/dn grid hotbar <rules>§r set hotbar rules (e.g. 0-3:ANY,4-8:GRID)
  §a/dn grid containers§r show container registration status
  §a/dn grid register|unregister <className>§r register/unregister a modded container
  §a/dn class ...§r item class colors (same as /dn class)
msg.dn.help.web:
§e/dn web§r web editor:
  §a/dn web§r show status and URL
  §a/dn web on§r start and enable auto-start
  §a/dn web off§r stop and disable auto-start
msg.dn.help.perm:
§e/dn perm§r permissions (targets support @a/@p/@s/@r/@e, OPs exempt by default):
  §a/dn perm get [target]§r show global defaults and player overrides
  §a/dn perm set <target> <warehouse|workbench|special|safe_box|trade|all> <allow|deny>§r set a player override
  §a/dn perm remove <target>§r remove an override
  §a/dn perm default <type|all> <allow|deny>§r set the global default
  §a/dn perm op <allow|deny>§r set whether OPs are exempt
  §a/dn perm getop§r show OP exemption state
msg.dn.help.feature:
§e/dn feature§r mod feature toggle:
  §a/dn feature get [target]§r show the toggle state
  §a/dn feature set <target> <allow|deny>§r enable/disable all mod features for the target
